title: MatVerse: A Foundation Model for Materials Science
abstract: arXiv:2611.25651v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Materials science involves highly heterogeneous scientific information, including textual knowledge, molecular and crystal structures, experimental characterization data, microscopy images, and structure-property relationships. Developing a general-purpose foundation model capable of understanding and reasoning over these diverse materials representations remains challenging. In this technical report, we introduce MatVerse, a materials foundation model built upon Intern-S2-Preview and further specialized through large-scale materials-domain post-training. We construct a large-scale multimodal training corpus covering materials knowledge, scientific reasoning, quantitative problem solving, structural understanding, and multimodal scientific interpretation. To improve domain adaptation, we develop a unified data construction pipeline combining teacher-guided reasoning distillation, scientific problem synthesis, consistency-based filtering,

translated_abstract: 材料科学涉及高度异构的科学信息，包括文本知识、分子与晶体结构、实验表征数据、显微镜图像以及构效关系等。开发一个能够理解并对这些多样化材料表示进行理解与推理的通用基础模型仍然充满挑战。在本技术报告中，我们提出了MatVerse，一个基于Intern-S2-Preview构建，并通过大规模材料领域后训练进一步专门化的材料基础模型。我们构建了一个大规模多模态训练语料库，涵盖材料知识、科学推理、定量问题求解、结构理解以及多模态科学解读等内容。为提升领域适应能力，我们开发了一个统一的数据构建流水线，将教师引导的推理蒸馏、科学问题合成、基于一致性的过滤等方法相结合……
tldr: 该论文提出MatVerse，一个基于Intern-S2-Preview并经大规模材料领域多模态后训练的材料科学基础模型，能够统一理解与推理文本知识、晶体结构、表征数据、显微图像等异构材料信息。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MatVerse, a materials science foundation model built on Intern-S2-Preview and specialized through large-scale multimodal materials-domain post-training, enabling unified understanding and reasoning over heterogeneous materials information including textual knowledge, crystal structures, characterization data, and microscopy images.
